# Beag Labs

> Customer-hosted agentic software for document automation, internal apps, and legacy modernization.

Official website: https://www.beaglabs.com/

## Solutions
- Document automation: https://www.beaglabs.com/solutions/document-automation
- Internal app creation: https://www.beaglabs.com/solutions/internal-app-factory
- Agentic modernization: https://www.beaglabs.com/solutions/agentic-modernization
- Papyrus: https://www.beaglabs.com/products/papyrus

## Technical context
Papyrus focuses on governed workflows and customer-controlled deployment. Technical capabilities include document processing, OpenAPI interfaces, and modernization patterns for legacy services. Capabilities and deployment specifics must be validated for each environment.
